svg.title: Complete modern SI prefix ladder
svg.desc: Vertical ladder of all 24 modern SI prefixes from quetta to quecto, with a no-prefix base-unit row and the eight engineering-critical prefixes from tera through pico highlighted
svg.text: SI PREFIX LADDER — COMPLETE MODERN SET
The highlighted rungs are the eight prefixes used most often in engineering calculations.
Prefixes are case-sensitive: M = mega, m = milli; k = kilo; µ = micro.
